description: Sample payloads for Empire Revenue OS demo and paid outreach
note: All payloads use persona/segment descriptions only — no real people, emails, or companies.

payloads.name: Empire-1 Demo (AI Revenue OS)
payloads.description: Use Empire-1 itself as the demo business to show the full revenue loop

payload.current_offer: Revenue OS for founders, creators, agencies, and local businesses
payload.target_customer: founders and small agencies who need money now
payload.links_or_notes: Empire Revenue OS command center is live and ready for paid outreach
payload.founder_context: Building the full revenue operating system across Money Pipeline, Pipeline Composer, Omni, billing, analytics, CRM/GTM, and execution logs
payload.assets_available: Revenue OS, Money Pipeline, Pipeline Composer, billing, analytics, execution logger, payment links
payload.constraints: Must be sellable immediately without waiting for perfect SaaS deployment

payloads.name: Agency Demo (Local Service Agency)
payloads.description: Show how an agency selling AI websites/automation gets a full revenue system

payload.links_or_notes: Needs a fast paid offer, buyer list, outreach plan, payment path, and delivery receipt
payload.founder_context: Solo founder with existing AI tools and ability to deliver manually
payload.assets_available: Landing page, GitHub repo, AI automation skills, Stripe/manual payment option
payload.constraints: Must be sellable immediately without waiting for perfect SaaS deployment

payloads.name: Creator Demo (Newsletter/Content Creator)
payloads.description: Show how a creator with an audience and newsletter gets a paid offer and revenue system

payload.links_or_notes: Has audience but no paid offer. Needs a fast revenue path without a product launch
payload.founder_context: Solo creator with existing audience on Instagram and email list
payload.assets_available: Email list (2K subs), Instagram (5K followers), Canva, basic video editing
payload.constraints: No SaaS product. Must sell a service or info product. No tech skills

payloads.name: Quick Receipt Demo (Fast Artifact)
payloads.description: Use the /revenue-receipt endpoint for a fast single artifact
